Financeit est un fournisseur de financement au point de vente au service de certaines des plus grandes entreprises de rénovation domiciliaire et de commerce de détail au Canada. Notre plateforme aide les entreprises à conclure plus de ventes en offrant à leurs clients des options de paiements mensuels abordables pour leur prochain grand projet de rénovation, d'achat de véhicule ou de commerce de détail.
 Nous sommes une entreprise à taille humaine où vous pouvez avoir un réel impact interne, mais suffisamment grande pour faire la différence sur le marché. Chez Financeit, la collaboration, l'inclusion, l'équité et le respect ne sont pas de simples paroles en l'air, mais font partie intégrante de notre ADN. Si ce milieu de travail vous interpelle, nous espérons que vous vous joindrez à nous.
 À propos du rôle : 
 En mettant l'accent sur la croissance du volume de ventes au Québec, le ou la responsable régional(e) des ventes aura pour mission d'entretenir les comptes existants ainsi que de prospecter et qualifier de nouveaux clients potentiels.
 Relevant du directeur des ventes pour l'Est du Canada, ce rôle B2B consiste à gérer les relations avec nos marchands partenaires et à traiter directement avec les propriétaires, les directeurs financiers et les représentants d'entreprises du secteur de la rénovation domiciliaire désireuses d'utiliser notre plateforme de financement aux consommateurs.
 Nous recherchons une personne motivée par les défis et axée sur la performance, stimulée par le dépassement des objectifs. Vous êtes un(e) spécialiste de la prospection (un « chasseur » d'expérience) à l'aise avec les appels à froid, et vous comprenez que la signature du contrat n'est que le début du travail. Vous savez rester organisé(e) tout en travaillant à un rythme soutenu et en prêtant attention aux détails, sans jamais perdre de vue la vision globale et en plaçant le succès client au cœur de vos priorités.
 Le ou la responsable devra consacrer au moins 30 % de son temps sur le terrain, à démarcher de nouveaux clients potentiels et à interagir avec les marchands partenaires au sein de son territoire. Il s'agit d'un poste en télétravail, et la personne retenue doit résider au Québec et être en mesure de se déplacer sur l'ensemble du territoire.
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Développer, maintenir et gérer de solides relations avec nos marchands partenaires en effectuant au moins une rencontre en personne par mois par marchand.
 Générer et conclure de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires dans les secteurs de la rénovation domiciliaire.
 Réactiver les comptes sous-performants existants qui vous sont attribués dans votre territoire.
 Utiliser une connaissance approfondie des produits et des conseils en vente pour stimuler l'activité des marchands.
 Mettre à jour et accompagner régulièrement les partenaires sur le programme et les processus de Financeit.
 Enseigner aux entreprises comment utiliser notre suite d'outils pour positionner le financement et proposer des mensualités.
 Organiser et animer des séances de formation et d'accompagnement régulières auprès des marchands.
 Veiller au respect de nos exigences en matière d'approbation et de gestion des risques.
 Assurer un suivi rigoureux par l'entremise de rapports quotidiens et hebdomadaires sur l'ensemble de vos activités de vente.
 Produire des rapports, analyser les données, dégager les tendances et formuler des recommandations.
 Signaler les lacunes dans les processus et systèmes aux niveaux de gestion appropriés dès qu'elles sont détectées.
 S'efforcer d'atteindre les objectifs individuels et d'équipe sur une base mensuelle.
 Déplacements requis.
 Diplôme d'études collégiales (DEC), baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.
 5 ans ou plus d'expérience pratique en vente directe et en gestion de relations clients.
 2 ans ou plus d'expérience dans le domaine du prêt à la consommation, des logiciels SaaS ou de la rénovation domiciliaire.
 Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais.
 Expertise démontrée dans la gestion réussie de relations de vente et de service B2B (un atout).
 Expérience de l'utilisation d'outils CRM, idéalement Salesforce.
 Excellentes compétences relationnelles et organisationnelles.
 Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités de front et à respecter des échéanciers serrés.
 Résider obligatoirement au Québec, Canada.
 Récipiendaire à deux reprises du prix Cultures d'entreprise les plus admirées au Canada. Nous offrons bien plus que le de base, profitez notamment de :
 Une culture d'entreprise primée au sein d'une équipe collaborative et inclusive.
 Un salaire compétitif et un bonus fondé sur la performance :
 Salaire de base annuel : 80 000 $ - 90 000 $
 Prime annuelle : 67 %
 Un engagement envers la flexibilité du travail, avec des options de travail hybride.
 Une couverture médicale, dentaire et de la vue complète + un compte Style de vie/Mieux-être.
 Des cotisations REER équivalentes par l'employeur et un programme de prestation complémentaire de congé parental.
 Des massages au bureau, des séances de méditation et d'entraînement physique.
 Des événements virtuels tels que des dîners-conférences, fêtes d'entreprise, activités d'équipe ludiques et initiatives de bienfaisance.
 Des programmes d'apprentissage et de développement professionnel.
 Prochaines étapes : 
 Si cette opportunité vous stimule, nous aimerions vous connaître! Soumettez votre candidature dès aujourd'hui et nous communiquerons avec vous si votre profil est retenu pour la suite du processus.
 Financeit est un employeur offrant l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi. Nous célébrons la diversité des parcours et des perspectives, car nous savons qu'elle renforce notre équipe et améliore notre produit. Nous embauchons en fonction du talent, du potentiel et de la valeur ajoutée à notre culture : peu importe vos origines, votre identité ou votre parcours de vie, vous êtes le ou la bienvenu(e) ici. 
 Veuillez noter que toutes les offres d'emploi sont conditionnelles à la réussite d'une vérification des antécédents et du crédit, entre autres vérifications.

Share in something more with a career at COBS Bread 
 2024 Top 50 Best Workplaces in Canada ™ by Great Place to Work

 Our Role 
 When you work with COBS Bread, you’re part of a workplace that is committed to providing you with an experience that will help you rise to any occasion. We’re here to encourage you to grow, connect with your community, have fun with your team, and to share in something more. We’ve got exciting plans in place for you as a passionate, inquisitive and eager team player who wants to make an impact.
 Your Role as Sales Assistant 
 At COBS Bread, we celebrate fresh. Our Sales Assistants are experts in freshness, and in giving our customers a great in-bakery experience. Right now, we are looking for personable Sales Assistant to share their enthusiasm for all things fluffy and sweet with our loyal customers. No experience necessary- just the right attitude and a willingness to learn.
 What Your Day Looks Like 
 Work as part of a small team, providing an exceptional customer experience, and getting to know your regular, loyal customers
 Be responsible for merchandising product and executing marketing campaigns
 Work alongside your team to keep the bakery clean, and assist with production as needed. (Yep- you’re going to learn how to do some baking!)
 Why You Were Bread for This 
 You are someone who takes pride in providing a great and personable experience for our customers
 You have a positive attitude and friendly demeanour
 You are reliable, self-motivated, and enjoys learning new skills
 You are a team player who is approachable and likes working with people
 Relevant retail experience and experience in handling cash, credit card and debit transactions is a strong asset
 Physical Requirements 
 Continuous standing/ walking for all tasks
 Constant use of both hands
 Frequent lifting and carrying up to 7.5 kg., reaching below shoulder level, bending and turning
 Occasional lifting and carrying up to 22 kg, pushing, pulling, crouching, bending and reaching above shoulder level
 Perks & What You’ll Feel Good About 
 A fun team work environment with flexible hours
 Our training program – Continue to develop your sales and leadership skills through our Bronze and Silver Sales Development Qualification program.
 Career advancement opportunities – We have a stake in helping passionate team members grow and have more impact in the business and community.
 Complimentary products on us every shift
 And more, including benefits for all full time employees
 While we thank you for your interest, only those selected for interviews will be contacted.
 About COBS Bread 
 With over 130 locations, COBS Bread serves fresh and delightful baked goods to communities across Canada every day. Any unsold items are donated daily to various local charities and food banks. The company's success can be attributed to the quality of our product, the development of our people, and our warm and friendly customer service.
 COBS Bread is part of Bakers Delight – Established in 1980 operating as Bakers Delight in Australia and New Zealand, and since 2003 as COBS Bread in Canada and the USA. Together we have grown to more than 700 bakeries across Australia, New Zealand, Canada and the USA. The entire network employs over 15,000 people, serving more than 2.1 million customers each week.
 Accessibility 
 Accommodation is available upon request for applicants and employees with disabilities. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to ensure you have access to a fair and equitable process. Any information received relating to accommodation will be addressed confidentially.

Background in supplier relationship management.

Passionate about self-driving technologies, solving hard problems, and creating innovative solutions.

Experience in the Autonomous or Electric Vehicle Industry.
MBA or JD.

L’Expérience Aviva 
 Individuellement, nous sommes des personnes, mais ensemble, nous formons Aviva. Ces mots prennent tout leur sens lorsqu’ils deviennent nos valeurs : Bienveillance, Engagement, Collectivité et Confiance .
 À Aviva Canada, nous plaçons les gens au premier plan : nos employés, nos clients et nos collectivités. Nous sommes fiers d’une culture fondée sur la bienveillance, l’inclusion et la collaboration, où votre voix compte et votre développement est soutenu. Nous ne faisons pas que de l’assurance; nous faisons une réelle différence en protégeant ce qui compte le plus.
 L’Opportunité 
 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Rédacteur(trice) principal(e), Production pour renforcer notre équipe responsable des comptes commerciaux de 50 000 $ et plus .
Dans ce rôle, vous évaluerez et sélectionnerez les risques complexes en assurance des biens et responsabilité civile, tout en jouant un rôle clé dans la croissance du portefeuille de l’assurance des entreprises. Vous serez l’interlocuteur privilégié des courtiers, gérerez vos renouvellements, saisirez les nouvelles occasions d’affaires et mettrez à profit votre expertise technique approfondie.
Ce poste représente une opportunité idéale pour un·e expert·e en souscription souhaitant évoluer dans une équipe performante, reconnue et collaborative.
 Ce que vous ferez 
 Analyser et sélectionner les affaires en identifiant les besoins et les caractéristiques de risque des clients.
 Collaborer avec l’équipe d’ingénierie afin d’interpréter les tendances et recommandations.
 Réaliser l’examen technique de tous les comptes complexes sous votre responsabilité.
 Assurer le suivi des recommandations en suspens auprès des partenaires internes.
 Développer et maintenir des relations solides avec les courtiers et autres intervenants internes.
 Préserver la qualité et la rentabilité du portefeuille de l’assurance des entreprises.
 Transférer au siège social les risques dépassant votre pouvoir décisionnel.
 Déceler les problématiques potentielles dans les ratios de sinistre et les tendances émergentes.
 Maîtriser les systèmes, outils et programmes informatiques liés à la souscription commerciale.
 Participer aux audits et contrôles de qualité.
 Maintenir à jour vos connaissances sur les tendances de l’industrie, les nouveautés et les changements réglementaires.
 Ce que vous apporterez 
 Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en assurance des entreprises (production).
 Excellente maîtrise du français à l’oral et à l’écrit. * Connaissance du français necessaire. 
 Forte capacité d’analyse des risques, de tarification et de connaissance des produits, notamment dans :
 la construction
 le manufacturier
 le commerce de détail
 le secteur du grossiste
 Connaissance approfondie des principes de sélection des risques, contrats d’assurance et programmes de tarification.
 Compréhension fonctionnelle des domaines connexes (indemnisation, gestion des risques, comptabilité).
 Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office.
 Aptitude à bâtir des relations durables avec les courtiers et les clients.
 Esprit collaboratif et capacité à travailler efficacement avec les équipes internes.
 Leadership positif, autonomie professionnelle et capacité à agir comme mentor.
 Capacité à comprendre et anticiper les besoins des courtiers et clients.
 Mon avantage unique 
 Expertise en souscription de risques complexes.
 Titres PAA / FPAA obtenus ou en voie d’obtention .
 Capacité à influencer, conseiller et collaborer efficacement.
 Leadership positif et orientation vers la performance.
 Motivation à faire croître un portefeuille stratégique.
 Ce que vous gagnerez 
 Un programme de rémunération complet comprenant le salaire de base, l’admissibilité à une prime annuelle, un régime d’épargne-retraite, un plan d’actionnariat, des avantages santé, des initiatives de bien-être et des occasions de bénévolat.
 Un modèle de travail hybride et flexible.
 Des occasions exceptionnelles de développement de carrière.
 Un régime de vacances compétitif, avec la possibilité d’acheter 5 jours supplémentaires par année.
 Des programmes dirigés par les employés, axés sur le genre, la communauté LGBTQ+, les origines, la diversité et l’inclusion.
 Des programmes de bien-être en entreprise pour soutenir la santé physique et mentale de nos employés.
 Cette offre d'emploi concerne un poste vacant existant qui a été affiché à la fois à l’interne et à l’externe.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

 

Vanta's Governance and Compliance platform is the operating layer enterprises trust to run their security programs. We are hiring an engineer who will own the architectural foundation that makes it work for their most complex organizational structures.

 

Program Structure and Trust is a newly chartered group at Vanta with a focused mission: build the enterprise org model that lets customers bring their compliance and security structure — product lines, business units, isolated data environments, cross-cutting audits, scoped approvals, and data residency requirements — natively into the platform. The problems this team solves determine whether Vanta can serve the enterprise customers it's increasingly winning.

 

This is the defining technical role of the group. The Staff Engineer owns the design, phased delivery, and long-term technical direction of Vanta's enterprise org model — a multi-quarter initiative that cuts across the platform and establishes the foundation for how enterprise customers structure, segment, and operate inside Vanta.

 

Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! 

 
 

What you'll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

 - Own the design and multi-quarter delivery of Vanta's enterprise org model, including hierarchical product lines and business units, isolated data access and ownership, cross-cutting audit workflows, scoped approvals, and EU and GovCloud data residency support

 - Define and evolve the core abstractions that let the platform absorb structurally diverse, often conflicting enterprise requirements — solving for the general case rather than one-off customer accommodations

 - Retrofit a live production system toward a multi-tenant org structure: design safe migration paths, sequence delivery incrementally, and preserve continuity for existing customers as the architecture evolves

 - Carve out and ship meaningful customer value each quarter while progressing toward the full solution — this requires product judgment, direct engagement with enterprise customers, and the discipline to draw clean increment lines through a complex problem space

 - Drive execution across squads outside your direct area, building alignment through technical clarity and credibility rather than authority

 - Partner with Engineering leadership, Product, and Design to translate the long-term vision for enterprise structure into phased, deliverable work

 - Set the technical standard for the group — define patterns others build to, shape architecture across teams, and model the engineering excellence the Program Structure and Trust charter is organized around

 

How to be successful in this role:

 - 10+ years of deep backend engineering experience with a track record of leading complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives in fast-paced, product-focused environments

 - Designed platform abstractions that absorbed messy, conflicting enterprise requirements across a diverse customer base — you've solved for the general case, not the loudest customer request

 - A track record of shipping in stages: you've moved large, structurally complex problems forward incrementally, with each phase standing on its own, without getting ahead of what customers and the product can absorb

 - A history of operating effectively across squads and teams you don't own — alignment built through technical clarity and credibility, not org chart proximity

 - Deep familiarity with enterprise architectural patterns: tenancy models, role-based access control, data isolation, scoped permissions, cross-tenant operations, and access boundary design

 - Data residency or GovCloud exposure is a plus; the right person ramps on this in a quarter once the core structural problems are in hand

 SUMMARY OF DUTIES 
 Reporting to the Supervisor, Infrastructure & Operations (Datacentre Operations), the Network Analyst II troubleshoots, supports and assists in maintaining server infrastructure, operating systems, storage systems, virtualization & container platforms, cloud environments, backup & recovery solutions, and physical datacentre facilities to meet the functional objectives of the business. This includes both physical, virtual & cloud environments supporting development and production applications, email & collaboration services, and disaster recovery across the City’s divisions. The principal focus of this role is on the provision of day-to-day operational support, with some project & service improvement activity as required.
 The Network Analyst II supports and maintains server hardware/software, storage systems, backup & recovery solutions, Microsoft Azure, AWS or comparable enterprise cloud infrastructure and the City’s messaging and collaboration platforms while contributing to proactive monitoring, repeatable and technology-enabled process improvements, and modernization efforts. This individual works with facility, hardware/software, and cloud vendors to ensure timely problem resolution and reliable service delivery. The position investigates and completes assigned incidents, service requests and operational work and escalates matters outside its authority or technical scope. The incumbent maintains & uses operations management applications to identify faults, ensure the provision of data & other datacenter services to customers, and support the reliable storage, protection & recovery of data.
 GENERAL DUTIES 
 Reviews incidents, problem logs and service requests relating to datacentre operations, initiates and follows through with resolution, provides second-level support for server infrastructure issues escalated by the Service Desk, documents investigation findings and escalates matters outside the position’s authority or technical scope.
 Assists in configuring, installing, troubleshooting and maintaining datacentre systems, including physical and virtual servers, storage, backup and recovery solutions, hypervisors, container platforms and cloud resources, while maintaining approved infrastructure configurations, technical baselines and change-management requirements.
 Supports identity, access and infrastructure security administration by maintaining authorized users, service accounts, permissions, credentials, certificates and infrastructure secrets in accordance with approved requests, least-privilege principles and segregation-of-duties requirements.
 Supports server, storage, virtualization and hybrid cloud platforms, including VMware, Hyper-V, Azure and AWS environments, and contributes to performance monitoring, capacity planning, scalability and cloud cost-management activities.
 Assists in developing and maintaining technical support and end-user documentation on technologies and services, including operating procedures, configuration information, knowledge articles, recovery instructions and support records.
 Researches, tests, and implements approved software patches, firmware/BIOS updates, configuration changes and hardware replacements in accordance with established change controls. Performs backup, restoration, replication and disaster-recovery activities across approved on-premises and cloud platforms. Validates backup and restoration results against established recovery requirements and documents deficiencies, dependencies, corrective actions and risks that could affect service recoverability.
 Monitors & supports the physical datacentre environment including power, cooling, UPS/PDUs, temperature, humidity, fire suppression, cabling, racking, and physical security/access controls. Reports environmental, equipment, safety & security concerns through the appropriate operational & management channels.
 Monitors infrastructure using approved observability and alerting tools, responds to alerts, and ensures infrastructure logs, events and operational telemetry are available to approved monitoring and security platforms to support proactive issue identification and resolution.
 Participates in patch management, vulnerability remediation, change management, lifecycle management, problem management and post-incident reviews, supporting root-cause analysis, remediation activities and continuous service improvement.
 Contributes to infrastructure service improvement through scripting and automation initiatives, including the development, testing, documentation and maintenance of approved scripts and repeatable solutions using appropriate version control, change management and security validation practices.
 Supports Microsoft 365, Exchange, Teams and related collaboration services, and supports cloud-governance requirements including resource organization, policy compliance, monitoring, lifecycle management, cost visibility and resource optimization.
 Ensures compliance with applicable cybersecurity, privacy, records-management, secure-configuration, backup/recovery and change-management requirements, supports secure integration with OT/industrial systems where required, and escalates risks or requirements outside the position's authority or technical scope.
 Assists with asset management and CMDB updates for datacentre hardware and software, cloud resources, configurations, ownership, support status and lifecycle information.
 Supports the operational acceptance and transition of new or changed technologies by confirming monitoring, support procedures, access requirements, documentation, backup and recovery arrangements, security controls, vendor contacts, licensing, knowledge transfer and escalation processes before implementation or operational handover.
 Works with facility, hardware, software and cloud vendors, consultants and managed-service providers to investigate issues, coordinate maintenance and complete assigned deliverables.
 Delivers infrastructure services, operational requests, projects and assigned work in accordance with approved priorities, service demand, risk and available team capacity, and supports other infrastructure functions and initiatives where operational requirements and demonstrated capability permit.
 Works in accordance with the provisions of applicable Health and Safety legislation and all City of Hamilton corporate and departmental policies and procedures related to Occupational Health and Safety. Uses required equipment, materials and safe-work procedures and promptly reports hazards, incidents and unsafe conditions through the appropriate channels.
 The duties are not exhaustive and may evolve based on operational needs, organizational priorities, emerging risks and technological changes. The incumbent may perform other related duties and assigned work consistent with the position.
 May be required to provide on-call support to users.
 May be required to work extended hours, nights, and weekends, to complete system maintenance.
 QUALIFICATIONS

 Two (2) to five (4) years of progressive experience in supporting enterprise infrastructure, server platforms, operating systems, storage, virtualization, backup and recovery, cloud services and datacentre operations.
 Solid experience with current Windows Server, Linux, virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V), and Microsoft Azure, AWS or comparable enterprise cloud platforms.
 Experience supporting and maintaining physical and virtual servers, server hardware, SAN, enterprise storage, backup & recovery solutions, replication and disaster-recovery technologies.
 Experience supporting Microsoft 365 infrastructure, Exchange, Teams, messaging, collaboration and unified communications services. Experience with Cisco Unified Communications or comparable platforms is considered an asset.
 Demonstrated analytical, troubleshooting, planning, scripting, and problem-solving skills, including PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar automation technologies. Experience applying testing, documentation, and change-control practices to repeatable solutions is an asset.
 Working knowledge of networking and identity technologies, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, authentication services, service accounts, permissions, firewalls, load balancing, and related enterprise infrastructure dependencies.
 Experience supporting infrastructure security controls, endpoint protection, anti-malware, endpoint detection and response (EDR), patch management, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, least-privilege principles, security-by-design, defence-in-depth, Zero Trust, and related cybersecurity best practices.
 Experience with infrastructure monitoring, observability, alerting, logging, operational telemetry, capacity planning, performance tuning, service restoration, and integration with approved monitoring and security platforms.
 Knowledge of ITIL and IT service management practices, including incident, request, problem, change, configuration, asset, and knowledge management. Experience implementing approved infrastructure configurations, technical baselines, and identifying configuration drift or unsupported components is required.
 Experience supporting relational database technologies, including Microsoft SQL Server and Oracle, and their associated infrastructure, availability, storage, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery dependencies. Experience supporting backup restoration, replication, and disaster recovery testing is required.

Strong leadership, interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills are required. Knowledge of cloud governance, version control, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, vendor coordination, applicable legislation, and industry certifications (Microsoft, Azure, AWS, VMware, Linux, Storage, Backup, Cloud, or ITIL) are considered assets.

 L’analyste en gestion de projets TI (PCO) senior agit à titre de conseiller en planification, suivi, contrôle et information de gestion des projets sous la responsabilité du Bureau de projets en technologies de l’information (BPTI). Il soutient les chargés de projet, les gestionnaires et les instances de gouvernance dans la planification, le suivi et la coordination des projets TI, notamment en ce qui concerne la portée, les échéanciers, les coûts, les risques, les dépendances et les bénéfices.
 La personne titulaire du mandat contribue à la mise en place, à l’application et à l’amélioration continue des mécanismes de gouvernance, des cadres, des méthodes et des outils de gestion de projets approuvés par l’organisation. Elle soutient la prise de décision par la production d’analyses, de tableaux de bord, de rapports d’avancement et de reddition de comptes fiables, structurés et cohérents.
 Dans un contexte multi-équipes et multipartenaires, elle favorise une gestion rigoureuse, transparente et uniforme des projets, tout en accompagnant les intervenants dans l’utilisation des outils, processus et pratiques recommandés par le BPTI.
 De manière plus spécifique, les principaux champs d’action sont les suivants :
 Planification et contrôle des projets
 - Soutenir la planification intégrée des projets, incluant la priorisation, la gestion de la capacité et l’allocation des ressources
 - Collaborer avec les chargés de projet à l’élaboration, à la mise à jour et au suivi des planifications de projet
 - Assurer le suivi de l’avancement des projets, notamment en ce qui concerne la portée, les échéanciers, les coûts, les risques, les dépendances et les bénéfices, en appui au chargé de projet responsable
 - Veiller à l’intégrité et à la qualité des données de planification dans les outils de gestion de projet
 - Contribuer aux activités de démarrage, de suivi et de fermeture des projets
 Gouvernance et reddition de comptes
 - Mettre en place et maintenir les mécanismes de gouvernance du portefeuille de projets TI, en cohérence avec les orientations et pratiques du BPTI
 - Participer à la préparation et à l’animation des instances de gouvernance et de reddition de comptes, notamment les comités de suivi, les comités de portefeuille et les comités décisionnels
 - Produire les tableaux de bord, rapports d’avancement et indicateurs de performance requis pour les différentes instances de gouvernance
 - Préparer les présentations, documents de suivi et comptes rendus destinés aux comités
 - Assurer le suivi des décisions, actions, points en suspens et engagements
 - Contribuer à l’amélioration des indicateurs et des mécanismes de suivi du portefeuille de projets
 Assurance qualité et conformité
 - Soutenir le chargé de projet dans la conformité des projets aux exigences organisationnelles, méthodologiques et normatives en vigueur
 - Analyser l’état de conformité des projets aux cadres, processus et bonnes pratiques de gestion de projet
 - Réaliser des contrôles de qualité sur les livrables de gestion de projet
 - Assurer la traçabilité des décisions, actions, risques, enjeux et informations de gestion pertinentes
 - Identifier les écarts, recommander les correctifs appropriés et en assurer le suivi
 - Participer aux activités d’assurance qualité de l’information de gestion et de la documentation des projets
 Suivi financier et information de gestion
 - Consolider et analyser l’information de gestion provenant des équipes de projets afin d’en assurer la qualité, la cohérence et la fiabilité
 - Assurer le suivi des efforts, des coûts, des engagements et de l’information financière des projets
 - Produire et maintenir des tableaux de bord de gestion, incluant les indicateurs de performance, les états d’avancement, les risques, les enjeux et les éléments nécessitant une attention particulière
 - Effectuer les conciliations nécessaires entre les données de projet et les données financières disponibles
 - Participer aux analyses de tendance, aux prévisions et au contrôle des écarts
 - Produire les indicateurs financiers et les rapports requis pour soutenir la prise de décision
 Soutien aux équipes de projet
 - Soutenir les chargés de projet, Scrum Masters, RTE et autres intervenants dans l’application des pratiques de gestion de projets, qu’elles soient traditionnelles, agiles ou hybrides
 - Utiliser et soutenir l’utilisation des outils de gestion de projets et de suivi recommandés par le BPTI, notamment Azure DevOps et les outils de suivi corporatifs
 - Agir à titre de personne-ressource pour l’utilisation des outils, gabarits et méthodologies de gestion de projet
 - Accompagner les chargés de projet dans l’application des processus et standards organisationnels
 - Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus, outils et pratiques de gestion de projets et de portefeuille

 - Favoriser l’uniformisation des pratiques de gestion de projet au sein de la VPTI

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era.  The Agent Gateway Team
 The Agent Gateway team owns the identity-aware infrastructure that connects enterprise AI agents to the tools, data, and services their organizations authorize. Every call from Claude, Agentforce, Codex, and internal/homegrown agents to a resource flows through us. We enforce authorization, isolate credentials, mint the right token per target, and produce the audit trails that security teams rely on.
 We are early in a rapidly evolving space. The standards for agent identity (MCP, OAuth token exchange, DCR) are being built under our feet. Our roadmap includes hardening the data plane for on-premises customer deployments, extending policy semantics beyond tool-level allowlists, adding native support for Agent-to-Agent brokered delegation, and scaling to tenants with thousands of virtual MCP servers.
 The Senior Software Engineer Opportunity
 Okta is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the Agent Gateway. You will own features and components across the data and control planes, turning technical designs and product requirements into reliable production systems. Working alongside staff engineers, you will implement token exchange, request routing, credential resolution, and policy evaluation as agent identity specifications evolve.
 This is a hands-on software development role at the intersection of product, security, and infrastructure. You will ship services that handle agentic traffic reliably and performantly at scale.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Build and Ship: Own the implementation of gateway features end-to-end — from virtual MCP server aggregation to token exchange and policy evaluation — with tests, observability, and operational readiness built in.
 Work in the Runtime Path: Write code that handles credentials, tokens, tenant isolation, and audit logging with care. The gateway sits in the critical path for customer agent traffic, so correctness and reliability matter on every change.
 Implement the Protocols: Read and implement MCP, OAuth token exchange, and agent identity specifications, and feed production lessons back into designs and reference implementations.
 Ship With Agentic Tooling: Use Claude, Claude Code, and MCP-connected agents as everyday parts of your workflow across design, code generation, code review, and operations.
 Contribute to Quality: Participate in code review, testing, incident response, and our design-doc culture, and help raise the team's engineering bar.
 What You'll Bring to the Role
 Experience: 4+ years building production backend systems, ideally distributed and highly available.
 Technical Depth: Proficiency shipping production services in Java and/or Go.
 Domain Knowledge: Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC, and comfort reading and implementing spec-driven code. Familiarity with RFC 8693 token exchange is a plus.
 Operational Sense: Hands-on experience with service rollouts, feature flags, observability, and incident response.
 Agentic Fluency: Working familiarity with agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, MCP servers, AI-assisted code review), with a point of view on where they accelerate work.
 Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to collaborate across a data plane service and a larger identity control plane.
 Extra Credit
 Experience building or integrating with an MCP server, an agent framework, or an LLM-facing gateway.
 Prior work on multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
 Exposure to identity, authorization, or edge-of-network services.
 Active participation in standards work in the agent identity space (MCP, OAuth, GNAP, DCR).
 Full-stack or frontend experience for the gateway's admin and configuration surfaces.

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. 
 That is the whole job.
 Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
 So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
 At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
 You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
 Here is what "end to end" actually means.
 You are the account manager. We do not have any.  You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
 You own the whole funnel, not the campaign.  Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
 You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.  We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
 You can live anywhere.  We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
 If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
 If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
 What the job looks like 
 Own a set of DTC accounts  as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
 Own the client relationship.  There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
 Audit before you touch anything.  Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
 Run brand and non brand as different businesses.  Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
 Know what PMax is actually doing.  The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
 Keep Google's automation on a leash.  Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
 Own the feed.  Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
 Own the tracking.  GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
 Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.  Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
 Build the things the account needs.  Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.
 You are a fit if 
 You have done this with real money.  Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
 You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
 You are AI native, and you build.  This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
 You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level.  You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
 You are skeptical of your own numbers.  You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
 You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls.  Where you live is up to you.
 Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.
 You are not a fit if 
 "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
 You want to be told what to do this week.
 You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
 You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
 Why this role is exciting 
 This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.
 You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.
 You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.
 You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

Our vision

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, electricians, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want.



Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.




THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer to join our Foundations team, which is responsible for the systems, patterns, and surfaces that help us build consistent, high-quality experiences. You’ll play a leadership role in shaping and evolving Jobber’s design system across our entire product suite on multiple platforms. In an evolving age of AI design and development, you will help establish new ways to think about how people and tools incorporate design system ideas into their work. You’ll lead major projects and initiatives that raise design standards across the company, improving consistency and team velocity.

Our team collaborates closely with designers, product managers, and engineers across the company. You’ll work at the intersection of design, engineering, and systems thinking to help other teams build better experiences, faster, and to turn people’s good ideas into great experiences that are easier to build and ship, and that endure over time.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Lead design system initiatives to create systems of components and product-level interaction patterns that scale across platforms

 - Be the steward of Jobber’s brand and experience principles, helping to foster thoughtful, high-quality visual and interaction design across the company

 - Identify gaps in the system and proactively drive solutions that improve consistency and usability at scale, and raise the bar for UX quality

 - Define and evolve governance models, contribution processes, and best practices

 - Partner closely with Engineering leaders to raise implementation quality across the company, and to improve how we incorporate system best practices into AI-backed design and development tools and workflows

 - Collaborate regularly with other designers and embed in product teams to support system adoption, share best practices, and to inform system iteration

 - Steer UX quality initiatives and roadmap planning to improve visual design, interaction design, accessibility, usability, and performance

 - Mentor others to build a strong culture of collaboration, feedback, and continuous improvement


TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU SHOULD HAVE:

 - A portfolio demonstrating your design craft, systems thinking, and measurable impact on product quality or team efficiency

 - 5-10 years experience designing and evolving design systems, including work on major initiatives like system redesigns or creating new products

 - A track record of leading complex projects or initiatives that improved design consistency and quality across an organization

 - Deep expertise in interaction design, UI patterns, and visual design

 - Deep understanding of accessibility standards across platforms

 - Expertise collaborating closely with engineers and understanding how design translates to code

 - Strong technical literacy with front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, and frameworks like React)

 - Strong expertise with Figma (components, tokens, auto-layout, prototyping)

 - Strong opinions about the evolving AI design landscape, including how people design, prototype, share patterns, and document work

 - A track record of making effective decisions that scale across organizations, balancing flexibility with standardization

 - Proven ability to work cross-functionally across an organization, build alignment with senior leaders, and inform strategy


BONUS POINTS

 - Experience scaling a design system in a fast-growing, multi-product environment

 - Experience designing complex software-as-a-service (SaaS) tools for business (B2B), especially for small-business customers (SMB)

 - Coding skills including experience with Typescript — ability to implement tokens and improve component quality, hands-on

 - Passion for blending roles, extending design into code and vice-versa

Our Hiring Process:

You can expect the interview process to include the following steps:

 - Talent Team Interview (45 min): An introduction to Jobber, your background, and what you’re looking for.

 - Portfolio Review (60 min): A deep dive into selected projects to understand your design process, decision-making, and impact.

 - Functional Whiteboard Exercise (75 min): A collaborative problem-solving session to see how you approach ambiguity and work through complex UX challenges.

 - Cross-Functional Interview (30 min): A conversation about your approach to cross-functional collaboration, including communication, feedback, and decision-making with product and engineering partners.

Location:

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and supportive of your experience and growth. Our salary ranges are designed to reflect the progression from learning the role to truly excelling. This role has an annual salary of:

Canada: minimum annual salary of $169,200 CAD, a midpoint of $199,100, and a maximum salary of $228,900 CAD.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience, and the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.

 - A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

 - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.



A bit more about us:

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!
